fusions.name: Hard Closure
fusions.desc: A crushing bite that deals 16 damage, leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Rasping Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps every enemy within 2.5 tiles for 7 damage, each with a 30% chance of [Sundered] for 6 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Stand Fast
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Cold Resolve
fusions.desc: Conjures a hardened hide over you: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, and 6% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
